title: 2003 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Each of the twenty dots on the graph below represents one of Sarah’s classmates. Classmates who are friends are connected with a line segment. For her birthday party, Sarah is inviting only the following: all of her friends and all of those classmates who are friends with at least one of her friends. How many classmates will not be invited to Sarah’s party?

solutions.text:
Sarah invites her friends and the classmates who are friends with at least one of her friends. In graph terms, she invites dots that are \(1\) or \(2\) line segments away from Sarah.

From the graph, \(4\) dots are disconnected from Sarah’s component, and \(2\) more dots in Sarah’s component are \(3\) segments away.

Those \(4+2=6\) classmates will not be invited.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Sarah invites vertices at distance \(1\) or \(2\) from her.
Count the dots not within two line segments of Sarah.
